requirements.quote: In the case of a vehicle fitted with an ARHSS, which could change the vehicle height at the front axle more than 20 mm from the nominal for any vehicle speed between 25 and 40 km/h, the provisions of paragraphs 5.1. and 5.2. shall, in addition to the normal running condition as specified by the manufacturer for a vehicle speed of 40 km/h, be met for all adjustable vehicle steady heights corresponding to vehicle speeds from 25 up to 40 km/h.

requirements.text: For these tests, on request of the manufacturer and agreed by the technical service, either the impact speeds defined in paragraphs 5.1. and 5.2. or the impact speed corresponding to the adjusted vehicle height shall be used.

requirements.quote: A detailed description, including photographs and/or drawings, of the vehicle with respect to the structure, the dimensions, the relevant reference lines and the constituent materials of the frontal part of the vehicle (interior and exterior) shall be provided.

requirements.text: The detailed description shall include detail of any active protection system installed.

requirements.quote: The cut-body shall include, in the test, all parts of the vehicle front structure, all under-bonnet components and all components behind the windscreen that may be involved in a frontal impact with a vulnerable road user

requirements.text: The cut-body shall include, in the test, all under-bonnet components that may be involved in a frontal impact with a vulnerable road user.
requirements.quote: all under-bonnet components and all components behind the windscreen that may be involved in a frontal impact with a vulnerable road user

requirements.text: The cut-body shall include, in the test, all components behind the windscreen that may be involved in a frontal impact with a vulnerable road user.
requirements.quote: all components behind the windscreen that may be involved in a frontal impact with a vulnerable road user

requirements.text: The cut-body shall be securely mounted in the normal vehicle ride attitude.
requirements.quote: The cut-body shall be securely mounted in the normal vehicle ride attitude.

requirements.text: All devices designed to protect vulnerable road users when impacted by the vehicle shall be correctly activated before and/or be active during the relevant test.
requirements.quote: All devices designed to protect vulnerable road users when impacted by the vehicle shall be correctly activated before and/or be active during the relevant test.

requirements.text: The manufacturer shall show that any devices will act as intended in a pedestrian impact.
requirements.quote: It shall be the responsibility of the manufacturer to show that any devices will act as intended in a pedestrian impact.

requirements.text: The flexible lower legform impactor shall consist of flesh and skin, flexible long bone segments (representing femur and tibia), and a knee joint as shown in Figure 1.
requirements.quote: The flexible lower legform impactor shall consist of flesh and skin, flexible long bone segments (representing femur and tibia), and a knee joint as shown in Figure 1.

requirements.text: The assembled flexible lower legform impactor shall have a total mass of 13.2 kg ± 0.4 kg.
requirements.quote: The assembled impactor shall have a total mass of 13.2 kg ± 0.4 kg.

requirements.text: The dimensions of the fully assembled flexible lower legform impactor shall be as defined in Figure 1.
requirements.quote: The dimensions of the fully assembled impactor shall be as defined in Figure 1.

requirements.text: A minimum of three lower legform to bumper tests shall be carried out, one each to the middle and the outer thirds of the bumper test area at positions judged to be the most likely to cause injury.
requirements.quote: A minimum of three lower legform to bumper tests shall be carried out, one each to the middle and the outer thirds of the bumper test area at positions judged to be the most likely to cause injury.

requirements.text: Tests shall be to different types of structure, where they vary throughout the area to be assessed.
requirements.quote: Tests shall be to different types of structure, where they vary throughout the area to be assessed.

requirements.text: The selected test points shall be a minimum of 84 mm apart as measured horizontally and perpendicular to the longitudinal median plane of the vehicle.
requirements.quote: The selected test points shall be a minimum of 84 mm apart as measured horizontally and perpendicular to the longitudinal median plane of the vehicle.

requirements.text: The positions tested by the laboratories shall be indicated in the test report.
requirements.quote: The positions tested by the laboratories shall be indicated in the test report.

requirements.text: The bottom of the flexible lower legform impactor (without parts needed for the purposes of launching and/or protection) shall be at 75 mm above ground reference plane at the time of first contact with the bumper (see Figure 4), with a ±10 mm tolerance.
requirements.quote: The bottom of the impactor (without parts needed for the purposes of launching and/or protection) shall be at 75 mm above ground reference plane at the time of first contact with the bumper (see Figure 4), with a ±10 mm tolerance.

requirements.text: When setting the height of the propulsion system, an allowance shall be made for the influence of gravity during the period of free flight of the flexible lower legform impactor.
requirements.quote: When setting the height of the propulsion system, an allowance shall be made for the influence of gravity during the period of free flight of the impactor.

requirements.text: The impact velocity of the flexible lower legform impactor when striking the bumper shall be 11.1 m/s ± 0.2 m/s.
requirements.quote: The impact velocity of the impactor when striking the bumper shall be 11.1 m/s ± 0.2 m/s.

requirements.text: The effect of gravity shall be taken into account when the impact velocity is obtained from measurements taken before the time of first contact.
requirements.quote: The effect of gravity shall be taken into account when the impact velocity is obtained from measurements taken before the time of first contact.

requirements.text: The tibia bending moments of the flexible lower legform impactor shall not exceed +/- 15 Nm within an evaluation interval of 30 ms immediately prior to impact.
requirements.quote: The tibia bending moments shall not exceed +/- 15 Nm within an evaluation interval of 30 ms immediately prior to impact.

requirements.text: A minimum of three upper legform to bumper tests shall be carried out, one each to the middle and the outer thirds of the bumper test area at positions judged to be the most likely to cause injury.
requirements.quote: A minimum of three upper legform to bumper tests shall be carried out, one each to the middle and the outer thirds of the bumper test area at positions judged to be the most likely to cause injury.

requirements.text: The selected measuring points shall be a minimum of 84 mm apart as measured horizontally and perpendicular to the longitudinal median plane of the vehicle.
requirements.quote: The selected measuring points shall be a minimum of 84 mm apart as measured horizontally and perpendicular to the longitudinal median plane of the vehicle.

requirements.text: The direction of impact shall be parallel to the longitudinal axis of the vehicle, with the axis of the upper legform vertical at the time of first contact.
requirements.quote: The direction of impact shall be parallel to the longitudinal axis of the vehicle, with the axis of the upper legform vertical at the time of first contact.

requirements.text: The tolerance to the direction of impact shall be ±2°.
requirements.quote: The tolerance to this direction is ±2°.

requirements.text: At the time of first contact the impactor centre line shall be vertically midway between the upper bumper reference line and the lower bumper reference line with a ±10 mm tolerance.
requirements.quote: At the time of first contact the impactor centre line shall be vertically midway between the upper bumper reference line and the lower bumper reference line with a ±10 mm tolerance

requirements.text: At the time of first contact the impactor vertical centre line shall be positioned laterally with the selected impact location with a tolerance of ±10 mm.
requirements.quote: the impactor vertical centre line shall be positioned laterally with the selected impact location with a tolerance of ±10 mm.

requirements.text: The impact velocity of the upper legform impactor when striking the bumper shall be 11.1 m/s ± 0.2 m/s.
requirements.quote: The impact velocity of the upper legform impactor when striking the bumper shall be 11.1 m/s ± 0.2 m/s.

requirements.text: The lighting and light-signalling devices shall be so fitted that under normal conditions of use as defined in paragraphs 2.3.10., 2.3.10.1. and 2.3.10.2. and notwithstanding any vibrations to which they may be subjected, they retain the characteristics prescribed by this Regulation.
requirements.quote: The lighting and light-signalling devices shall be so fitted that under normal conditions of use as defined in paragraphs 2.3.10., 2.3.10.1. and 2.3.10.2. and notwithstanding any vibrations to which they may be subjected, they retain the characteristics prescribed by this Regulation.

requirements.text: The lighting and light-signalling devices shall be so fitted that under normal conditions of use as defined in paragraphs 2.3.10., 2.3.10.1. and 2.3.10.2. and notwithstanding any vibrations to which they may be subjected, the lighting and light-signalling devices shall enable the vehicle to comply with the requirements of this Regulation.
requirements.quote: they retain the characteristics prescribed by this Regulation and enable the vehicle to comply with the requirements of this Regulation.

requirements.text: The lighting and light-signalling devices shall be so fitted that it shall not be possible for the lamps to be inadvertently maladjusted.
requirements.quote: In particular, it shall not be possible for the lamps to be inadvertently maladjusted.

requirements.text: The illuminating lamps described in paragraphs 2.5.1., 2.5.2. and 2.5.10. shall be so installed that correct adjustment of their orientation can easily be carried out.
requirements.quote: The illuminating lamps described in paragraphs 2.5.1., 2.5.2. and 2.5.10. shall be so installed that correct adjustment of their orientation can easily be carried out.

requirements.text: For all light-signalling devices, including those mounted on the side panels, the reference axis of the lamp when fitted to the vehicle shall be parallel to the bearing plane of the vehicle on the road.
requirements.quote: For all light-signalling devices, including those mounted on the side panels, the reference axis of the lamp when fitted to the vehicle shall be parallel to the bearing plane of the vehicle on the road;

requirements.text: For all light-signalling devices, including those mounted on the side panels, the reference axis of the lamp when fitted to the vehicle shall be perpendicular to the median longitudinal plane of the vehicle in the case of side retro-reflectors and of side-marker lamps.
requirements.quote: in addition it shall be perpendicular to the median longitudinal plane of the vehicle in the case of side retro-reflectors and of side-marker lamps

requirements.text: For all light-signalling devices, including those mounted on the side panels, the reference axis of the lamp when fitted to the vehicle shall be parallel to the median longitudinal plane of the vehicle in the case of all other signalling devices.
requirements.quote: and parallel to that plane in the case of all other signalling devices.

requirements.text: For all light-signalling devices, including those mounted on the side panels, a tolerance of ±3° shall be allowed in each direction for the reference axis of the lamp when fitted to the vehicle.
requirements.quote: In each direction a tolerance of ±3° shall be allowed.

requirements.text: The light-signalling devices shall comply with any specific instructions as regards fitting laid down by the manufacturer.
requirements.quote: In addition, any specific instructions as regards fitting laid down by the manufacturer shall be complied with.

requirements.text: In the absence of specific instructions, the height and orientation of the lamps shall be verified with the vehicle unladen and placed on a flat, horizontal surface, in the condition defined in paragraphs 2.3.10., 2.3.10.1. and 2.3.10.2. and, in the case where an AFS is installed, with the system in its neutral state.
requirements.quote: In the absence of specific instructions, the height and orientation of the lamps shall be verified with the vehicle unladen and placed on a flat, horizontal surface, in the condition defined in paragraphs 2.3.10., 2.3.10.1. and 2.3.10.2. and, in the case where an AFS is installed, with the system in its neutral state.

requirements.text: In the absence of specific instructions, the lamps constituting a pair shall be fitted to the vehicle symmetrically in relation to the median longitudinal plane (this estimate to be based on the exterior geometrical form of the lamp and not on the edge of its illuminating surface referred to in paragraph 2.10.3.).
requirements.quote: Be fitted to the vehicle symmetrically in relation to the median longitudinal plane (this estimate to be based on the exterior geometrical form of the lamp and not on the edge of its illuminating surface referred to in paragraph 2.10.3.);

requirements.text: In the absence of specific instructions, the lamps constituting a pair shall have substantially identical photometric characteristics, except that this shall not apply to a matched pair of a function and/or an AFS.
requirements.quote: Have substantially identical photometric characteristics. This shall not apply to a matched pair of a function and/or an AFS.

requirements.text: The photometric and colorimetric requirements of a lamp shall be fulfilled when all other functions with which this lamp is grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated are switched OFF, except that when a front or rear position lamp is reciprocally incorporated with one or more other function(s) which can be switched ON together with them, the requirements regarding colour of each of these other functions shall be fulfilled when the reciprocally incorporated function(s) and the front or rear position lamps are switched ON.
requirements.quote: The photometric and colorimetric requirements of a lamp shall be fulfilled when all other functions with which this lamp is grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated are switched OFF. However, when a front or rear position lamp is reciprocally incorporated with one or more other function(s) which can be switched ON together with them, the requirements regarding colour of each of these other functions shall be fulfilled when the reciprocally incorporated function(s) and the front or rear position lamps are switched ON.

requirements.text: When a single lamp as defined in paragraph 2.14.11.1., subparagraph (a), has an apparent surface composed of two or more distinct parts, the single lamp shall be installed in such a way that the total area of the projection of the distinct parts of the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis on a plane tangent to the exterior surface of the outer lens and perpendicular to the reference axis shall occupy not less than 60 per cent of the smallest quadrilateral circumscribing the projection of the said apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis, except that this requirement shall not apply to a single retro-reflector.
requirements.quote: Either the total area of the projection of the distinct parts of the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis on a plane tangent to the exterior surface of the outer lens and perpendicular to the reference axis shall occupy not less than 60 per cent of the smallest quadrilateral circumscribing the projection of the said apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis

requirements.text: When a single lamp as defined in paragraph 2.14.11.1., subparagraph (a), has an apparent surface composed of two or more distinct parts, the single lamp shall be installed in such a way that the minimum distance between the facing edges of two adjacent/tangential distinct parts of the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis shall not exceed 75 mm when measured perpendicularly to the reference axis, except that this requirement shall not apply to a single retro-reflector.
requirements.quote: The minimum distance between the facing edges of two adjacent/tangential distinct parts of the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis shall not exceed 75 mm when measured perpendicularly to the reference axis.

requirements.text: The maximum height above the ground shall be measured from the highest point of the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis.
requirements.quote: The maximum height above the ground shall be measured from the highest point and the minimum height from the lowest point of the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis.

requirements.text: The minimum height above the ground shall be measured from the lowest point of the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis.
requirements.quote: The maximum height above the ground shall be measured from the highest point and the minimum height from the lowest point of the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis.

requirements.text: The red light emitted by a lamp fitted on the rear of the vehicle (as defined in paragraph 2.1.5.) shall not be visible from the front of the vehicle.
requirements.quote: Red light emitted by a lamp fitted on the rear of the vehicle (as defined in paragraph 2.1.5.) shall not be visible from the front of the vehicle.

requirements.text: The white light emitted by a lamp fitted on the front of the vehicle (as defined in paragraph 2.1.5.) shall not be visible from the rear of the vehicle.
requirements.quote: White light emitted by a lamp fitted on the front of the vehicle (as defined in paragraph 2.1.5.) shall not be visible from the rear of the vehicle.

requirements.text: For the visibility of red light towards the front of a vehicle, with the exception of a red rearmost side-marker lamp, the apparent surface of a red lamp shall not be directly visible to an observer moving within Zone 1 in a transverse plane situated 25 m in front of the vehicle (see Annex 4).
requirements.quote: For the visibility of red light towards the front of a vehicle, with the exception of a red rearmost side-marker lamp, there shall be no direct visibility of the apparent surface of a red lamp if viewed by an observer moving within Zone 1 in a transverse plane situated 25 m in front of the vehicle (see Annex 4);

requirements.text: For the visibility of white light towards the rear of a vehicle, with the exception of reversing lamps and white side conspicuity markings, the apparent surface of a white lamp shall not be directly visible to an observer moving within Zone 2 in a transverse plane situated 25 m behind the vehicle (see Annex 4).
requirements.quote: For the visibility of white light towards the rear of a vehicle, with the exception of reversing lamps and white side conspicuity markings, there shall be no direct visibility of the apparent surface of a white lamp if viewed by an observer moving within Zone 2 in a transverse plane situated 25 m behind the vehicle (see Annex 4);

requirements.text: The electrical connections shall be such that the front and rear position lamps, the end-outline marker lamps, if they exist, the side-marker lamps, if they exist, and the rear registration plate lamp can only be switched ON and OFF simultaneously.
requirements.quote: The electrical connections shall be such that the front and rear position lamps, the end-outline marker lamps, if they exist, the side-marker lamps, if they exist, and the rear registration plate lamp can only be switched ON and OFF simultaneously.

requirements.text: In the case of an interdependent lamp system, all light sources shall be switched ON and OFF simultaneously.
requirements.quote: In the case of an interdependent lamp system, all light sources shall be switched ON and OFF simultaneously.

requirements.text: The electrical connections shall be such that the main-beam and dipped-beam headlamps and the front fog lamps cannot be switched ON unless the lamps referred to in paragraph 5.11. are also switched ON, except that this requirement shall not apply to main-beam or dipped-beam headlamps when their luminous warnings consist of the intermittent lighting up at short intervals of the main-beam headlamp or the intermittent lighting up at short intervals of the dipped-beam headlamp or the alternate lighting up at short intervals of the main-beam and dipped-beam headlamps.
requirements.quote: The electrical connections shall be such that the main-beam and dipped-beam headlamps and the front fog lamps cannot be switched ON unless the lamps referred to in paragraph 5.11. are also switched ON. requirements.text: When the movable components of the dipped-beam headlamps and front fog lamps are moved and returned to the normal position 10 times, the angular inclination of these lamps, relative to its support, measured after each operation of the movable component, shall not differ by more than 0.15 per cent from the average of the 10 measured values.

requirements.quote: Additional lamps satisfying all the position, geometric visibility, colorimetric and photometric requirements for the above indicated lamps shall be switched ON when the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis of these lamps is more than 50 per cent hidden by the movable component; or

requirements.text: If the requirement of paragraph 5.21. is not practicable, a remark in the communication form (item 10.1. of Annex 1) shall inform other Administrations that more than 50 per cent of the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis can be hidden by the movable components.
requirements.quote: A remark in the communication form (item 10.1. of Annex 1) shall inform other Administrations that more than 50 per cent of the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis can be hidden by the movable components; and

requirements.quote: A notice in the vehicle shall inform the user that in certain position(s) of the movable components other road users shall be warned of the presence of the vehicle on the road; for example by means of a warning triangle or other devices according to national requirements for use on the road.

requirements.quote: Number Two Class “F3” and type-approved according to the 03 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 19, or to the 00 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 149.

requirements.quote: or to the 00 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 149.

requirements.quote: In width: that point on the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis which is farthest from the vehicle's median longitudinal plane shall not be more than 400 mm from the extreme outer edge of the vehicle.

requirements.text: The front fog lamp shall be not less than 250 mm above the ground.
requirements.quote: Minimum: Not less than 250 mm above the ground.

requirements.quote: Maximum: For M1 and N1 category vehicles: not more than 800 mm above the ground.

requirements.text: No point on the apparent surface of the front fog lamp in the direction of the reference axis shall be higher than the highest point on the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis of the dipped-beam headlamp.
requirements.quote: No point on the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis shall be higher than the highest point on the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis of the dipped-beam headlamp.

requirements.text: The front fog lamp shall be located at the front of the vehicle.
requirements.quote: In length: at the front of the vehicle.

requirements.quote: This requirement shall be deemed to be satisfied if the light emitted does not cause discomfort to the driver either directly, or indirectly through the devices for indirect vision and/or other reflecting surfaces of the vehicle.

requirements.quote: ß = 45° outwards and 10° inwards.

requirements.text: The presence of partitions or other items of equipment near the front fog lamp shall not give rise to secondary effects causing discomfort to other road users.
requirements.quote: The presence of partitions or other items of equipment near the front fog lamp shall not give rise to secondary effects causing discomfort to other road users.

requirements.text: The front fog lamp shall be oriented toward the front.
requirements.quote: Orientation Toward the front.

requirements.text: When the total objective luminous flux of the light source for each front fog lamp does not exceed 2,000 lumens, the vertical inclination of the cut-off to be set in the unladen vehicle state with one person in the driver´s seat shall be –1.0 per cent or lower.
requirements.quote: The vertical inclination of the cut-off to be set in the unladen vehicle state with one person in the driver´s seat shall be – 1.0 per cent or lower.

requirements.text: When the total objective luminous flux of the light source for each front fog lamp exceeds 2,000 lumens, the vertical inclination of the cut-off of the front fog lamp shall under all the static conditions of Annex 5 automatically remain between -1.5 per cent and -3.5 per cent where the mounting height h in metres of the lower edge of the apparent surface is h > 0.8 (limits).
requirements.quote: h > 0.8 Limits: between -1.5 per cent and -3.5 per cent

requirements.text: When the total objective luminous flux of the light source for each front fog lamp exceeds 2,000 lumens, the initial aiming of the vertical inclination of the cut-off of the front fog lamp shall under all the static conditions of Annex 5 automatically remain between -2.0 per cent and -2.5 per cent where the mounting height h in metres of the lower edge of the apparent surface is h > 0.8.
requirements.quote: Initial aiming: between -2.0 per cent and -2.5 per cent.

requirements.text: The initial downward inclination of the cut-off to be set in the unladen vehicle state with one person in the driver's seat shall be specified within an accuracy of one decimal place by the manufacturer.
requirements.quote: The initial downward inclination of the cut-off to be set in the unladen vehicle state with one person in the driver's seat shall be specified within an accuracy of one decimal place by the manufacturer

requirements.text: The initial downward inclination of the cut-off set in the unladen vehicle state with one person in the driver's seat shall be indicated in a clearly legible and indelible manner on each vehicle close to either the front fog lamp or the manufacturer's plate or in combination with the indication referred to in paragraph 6.2.6.1.1. by the symbol shown in Annex 7 to this Regulation.
requirements.quote: shall be indicated in a clearly legible and indelible manner on each vehicle close to either the front fog lamp or the manufacturer's plate or in combination with the indication referred to in paragraph 6.2.6.1.1. by the symbol shown in Annex 7 to this Regulation

requirements.text: The value of the indicated downward inclination of the cut-off shall be defined in accordance with paragraph 6.3.6.1.2.1.
requirements.quote: The value of this indicated downward inclination shall be defined in accordance with paragraph 6.3.6.1.2.1.

requirements.text: Where a levelling device is fitted for a front fog lamp, independent or grouped with other front lighting and light signalling functions, the levelling device shall be such that the vertical inclination, under all the static loading conditions of Annex 5 of this Regulation, shall remain between the limits prescribed in paragraph 6.3.6.1.2.1.
requirements.quote: Where a levelling device is fitted for a front fog lamp, independent or grouped with other front lighting and light signalling functions, it shall be such that the vertical inclination, under all the static loading conditions of Annex 5 of this Regulation, shall remain between the limits prescribed in paragraph 6.3.6.1.2.1.

requirements.text: In the case where the front fog lamp is part of the dipped-beam headlamp or is part of an AFS system, the requirements of paragraph 6.2.6. shall be applied during the use of the front fog beam as part of the dipped beam.
requirements.quote: In the case where the front fog lamp is part of the dipped-beam headlamp or is part of an AFS system, the requirements of paragraph 6.2.6. shall be applied during the use of the front fog beam as part of the dipped beam.

requirements.text: In the case of a failure of the front fog lamp levelling device, the front fog beam shall not assume a position in which the cut-off is less inclined than it was at the time when the failure of the device occurred.
requirements.quote: In the case of a failure of the levelling device, the front fog beam shall not assume a position in which the cut off is less inclined than it was at the time when the failure of the device occurred.

requirements.quote: It shall be possible to switch the front fog lamps ON and OFF independently of the main-beam headlamps, the dipped-beam headlamps or any combination of main- and dipped-beam headlamps, unless: (a) The front fog lamps are used as part of another lighting function in an AFS

requirements.quote: and in such a way that no discomfort, neither for the driver nor to other road users, is caused.

requirements.text: The front position lamp shall be mandatory on all motor vehicles.
requirements.quote: Mandatory on all motor vehicles.

requirements.quote: Mandatory on trailers over 1,600 mm wide.

requirements.quote: Number Two, type-approved according to the 02 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 7, or to the 00 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 148.

requirements.text: The front position lamp's apparent surface point farthest from the vehicle's median longitudinal plane in the direction of the reference axis shall not be more than 400 mm from the extreme outer edge of the vehicle.

requirements.quote: For all other categories of vehicles: Not less than 600 mm. This distance may be reduced to 400 mm where the overall width of the vehicle is less than 1,300 mm.

requirements.text: The front position lamp shall be not less than 250 mm above the ground.
requirements.quote: In height: above the ground, not less than 250 mm nor more than 1,500 mm

requirements.quote: nor more than 1,500 mm (2,100 mm for O1 and O2 categories of vehicles, or if for any other categories of vehicles the shape of the bodywork makes it impossible to keep within 1,500 mm).

requirements.text: The front position lamp shall have a horizontal angle of 80° outwards.
requirements.quote: Horizontal angle: 45° inwards and 80° outwards.

requirements.quote: Vertical angle: 15° above and below the horizontal.

requirements.text: The front position lamp shall have a vertical angle of 15° below the horizontal, except that where the lamp is mounted below 750 mm (measured according to the provisions of paragraph 5.8.1. above), the downward angle of 15° may be reduced to 5°.

requirements.quote: For M1 and N1 category vehicles, as an alternative to paragraph 6.9.5.1. above, at the discretion of the manufacturer or his duly accredited representative, and only if a front side-marker lamp is installed on the vehicle: Horizontal angle: 45° outwards to 45° inwards. requirements.quote: However, where a lamp is mounted below 750 mm (measured according to the provisions of paragraph 5.8.1. above), the downward angle of 15° may be reduced to 5°.

requirements.quote: To be considered visible, the lamp shall provide an unobstructed view of the apparent surface of at least 12.5 cm2.

requirements.text: The front position lamp closed-circuit tell-tale shall be mandatory.

requirements.text: The front position lamp closed-circuit tell-tale shall be non-flashing.
requirements.quote: This tell-tale shall be non-flashing
